name: @pipeworx/mcp-mime

tools.name: lookup_mime
tools.description: Get the MIME (media) type for a filename or extension, e.g. "photo.png" or "png" -> "image/png". Keyless, offline.

file.description: A filename or bare extension, e.g. "report.pdf" or "pdf".

tools.name: extension_for
tools.description: Get the file extension(s) for a MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg" -> ["jpg","jpeg"]. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mime forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mime pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
